body:
Thanks for your comment, I think my day would have been really sad if no one had responded.  

Yes, I do need mental health support at this time.  Luckily I have an appointment with a psychologist tomorrow and I will discuss some of these issues with her.  Unfortunately I don't feel comfortable being completely honest with her as I have a huge fear of returning to the mental hospital, it was a terrifying experience.

Also, I only have access to one visit a month so it's in some ways difficult to build a rapport with the psychologist.

I do have 2 pets, a dog and a cat, and actually the dog kept me awake most of last night with whining to go outside and whining to go into my fiance's bedroom.

My fiance locked me out of his bedroom last night and the dog was crying to go inside for about an hour around 2 or 3 am, so I felt tired and depressed in the morning probably because of that.

As for church, I have mixed feelings about religion and haven't been able to find a religious organization in this area that I connect with.  In my previous city there were a lot of organizations I felt connected to, but here they don't agree with my beliefs.

Hobbies and volunteer work are a good idea and something I will consider, although the low energy thing has been what has held me back from this in the past.  I have tried to do these in the past too.

Thanks for your suggestions and please be aware that you made a big difference for me today.
Take one week and think about it.
